entries.headline: Six USAF cargo aircraft and other activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the United States and also noted reports of overnight Ukrainian drone strikes toward Moscow and U.S. naval movements.

entries.headline: Reuters sanctions-and-tariffs report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that President Donald Trump waived many Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before a new law was to take effect, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Five USAF cargo aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported five U.S. Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and elevated military flight activity across the region during the preceding six hours.

entries.headline: Ukrainian missile and drone raid into Russia relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a reagan0965 report of an ongoing Friday-night Ukrainian missile and attack-drone raid into Russia, with drones targeting the Moscow area and passing to its west.

entries.headline: UKMTO Strait of Hormuz attack-count statement relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a reagan0965 report quoting UKMTO as saying it was struggling to accurately report the true number of attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.headline: C-130J OTIS22 with hex AE6C1E spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Lockheed Martin C-130J Super Hercules using callsign OTIS22, hex AE6C1E and registration 170282, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Claude Davet via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Saudi-led coalition airstrike footage relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a reagan0965 report that the Saudi-led coalition had released footage showing Royal Saudi Air Force strikes targeting boats and vehicles.

entries.headline: Dammam air-traffic disruption claim relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an OSINTWarfare report of air-traffic disruptions over Dammam and an apparent Ansar Allah attack on King Fahd International Airport, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: US cargo and tanker aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. military cargo and refuelling aircraft airborne over the continental United States and the Middle East, including at least five tankers near the Persian Gulf.

entries.headline: VC-25A with hex ADFDF9 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing VC-25A with no callsign, hex ADFDF9 and registration 92-9000, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Ege Şanda via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Reported PJAK attacks in Kermanshah relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that the Iranian Kurdish separatist group PJAK was attacking several towns in Kermanshah Province, western Iran, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: KC-46A activity south of Kish Island reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force Boeing KC-46A Pegasus, registration 11-46059 and hex AE5FA6, from Al Udeid, Qatar, and described its operation as 50 kilometres south of Kish Island, Iran, citing alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: F-22 control of YFQ-44A flight highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a The Aviationist report that an F-22A Raptor controlled a YFQ-44A Collaborative Combat Aircraft during flight.

entries.headline: Gray Eagle ESM flight test highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Soldier Systems Daily report that General Atomics completed flight testing of a new Electronic Support Measures system on the MQ-1C Gray Eagle UAS.
